title: Vampire Vape Heisenberg Cola 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Heisenberg Cola Nic Salt adds a timeless twist to Vampire Vape’s award-winning flavour. The unmistakably sweet and frosty taste of Heisenberg fuses tangy Red Berries and brisk, icy Menthol in a combination that has become the stuff of legend. This iconic flavour takes on new life with the addition of classic cola flavour, enhancing the cool berry flavour with a timeless soda taste. This premium Nic Salt e-liquid provides an optimal balance of flavour and cloud production with its 50VG/50PG blend, making it perfect for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod vape devices. Vampire Vape's Heisenberg Cola Nic Salt is ideal for those recently transitioning from smoking or vapers looking for quick, satisfying nicotine relief along with a super-smooth throat hit. Utilizing nicotine salts' alkaline formulation, this e-liquid allows for a higher nicotine concentration while ensuring a smoother experience than high-strength freebase nicotine can offer. Nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, offering near-instant satisfaction of nicotine cravings, making it a superior choice for efficiency and comfort. Discover more new twists on Heisenberg with Heisenberg Grape, Gum and Orange Nic Salt flavours!
